tagline.en_US: PairDrop is a sublime alternative to AirDrop that works on all platforms. Send images, documents or text via peer to peer connection to devices in the same local network/Wi-Fi or to paired devices.

description.en_US: PairDrop is a cross-platform file and text sharing application that functions as an alternative to AirDrop. It enables devices on the same local network or Wi-Fi to discover each other and transfer images, documents, or text via direct peer-to-peer connections. It also supports sharing directly between paired devices.
